Interference of light from two slits - spatial view

Interferencja światła z dwóch szczelin - widok przestrzenny

λ = 500 nm

k = 2 · πλ = 2 · 3.141593500 nm = 0.01256637 nm-1

r ( x; y )  =    √ x2 + y2

d = 3 μm

c = 299792458 ms

T = λc = 500 nm299792458 m ∕ s = 1.66782×10-15 s

f = 1T = 11.66782×10-15 s = 599584916000000 Hz

ω = 2 · πT = 2 · 3.1415931.66782×10-15 s = 3767303134617706.5 s-1

Ψ0 = 0.5 ·   Wm2 = 0.5 kg0.5 ∕ s1.5

t = 0 s

Ψ2D_1 ( x; y; t )  = Ψ0 · cos(k · r (x − d2; y) − ω · t)

Ψ2D_2 ( x; y; t )  = Ψ0 · cos(k · r (x + d2; y) − ω · t)

Ψ2D ( x; y; t )  = Ψ2D_1  ( x; y; t )  + Ψ2D_2  ( x; y; t )
